result.instructions: Tools for Arketa, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which classes are booked this week, and how full is each one?"; "Who is booked into tomorrow's 7am class, and who has already checked in?"; "List the clients who joined in the last 30 days.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Arketa data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run arketa_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run arketa_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run arketa_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. arketa_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: arketa_create_reservation
tools.title: Book a client into a class
tools.description: WRITE: book one client into a class. Live data, no undo tool: it uses one credit from the purchase_id you pass. For an existing client give client_id and purchase_id. For a new client give first_name, last_name and email. Partner API: POST /{partnerId}/classes/{classId}/reservations.

client_id.description: An existing client id. Use with purchase_id.

purchase_id.description: The client's purchase to use (required with client_id).

annotations.title: Book a client into a class
